name: JCPRD 50 Plus Mah Jongg

address: Meadowbrook Park Clubhouse, 9101 Nall Ave, Prairie Village, KS
schedule: Drop-in 1-4pm: Tue New Century Fieldhouse; Wed Meadowbrook; Thu Tomahawk Ridge and Roeland Park; Tue Mill Creek 1-4pm and 5:15-7:15pm; suggested $1 donation
